notes.title: Stop support for Linux platform
notes.notes:
尊敬的玩家：
    很遗憾，我们要说明一些关于游戏在 Linux 平台上的重要通知。

    由于 RPG Maker MV 游戏引擎核心的升级，以往版本在 Linux 平台的游戏框架已经无法正常启动游戏。我们已经尽力进行了多次更新和测试，但非常遗憾的是由于一些未知的原因，新制作的游戏框架无法在 Steam 内部正常启动。因此在多次尝试未果之后，经过很久的抉择，我们决定停止继续直接支持 Linux 平台。我们知道这可能不是您期待的消息，我们对此决定深感抱歉并理解对您造成的不便。
    但是，我们并没有忘记 Linux 玩家。经过我们的测试，发现可以使用 游戏/应用属性 中的 Steam 自带的兼容性工具 "Proton 7.0-6" 来较为完美地运行游戏。我们希望这个解决方案能够帮助您继续享受我们的游戏。
    再次对给您带来的不便表示歉意，并感谢您的理解和支持。我们期待在未来的某一天能够再次直接在 Linux 平台上支持直接游玩。
祝您游戏愉快！



Dear players,
We regret to inform you about some important updates regarded the game on the Linux platform.

    Due to upgrades in the core of the RPG Maker MV game engine, previous versions of the game framework on Linux can no longer launch the game properly. Despite our efforts in multiple updates and tested, unfortunately, the newly created game framework cannot launch the game correctly within the Steam environment, for reasons unknown. Therefore, after numerous unsuccessful attempts and much deliberation, we have decided to cease direct support for the Linux platform. We understand that this may not be the news you were hoping for, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this decision may cause you.
    However, we have not forgotten about our Linux players. Through our tested, we have found that you can use the Compatibility Tools "Proton 7.0-6" provided by Steam in the Game/Application Properties to run the game relatively seamlessly. We hope this solution will help you continue enjoying our game.
    Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understand and support. We look forward to the possibility of supported direct play game on the Linux platform again someday in the future.

Wish you a pleasant gaming experience!
